threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still avoid the bike lanes during rush hour. Everyone else is doing a slalom around you, looking mildly entertained.
Caught a bloke singing opera on the 37 last night. Everyone was pretending not to listen, but the driver was loving it, tapping along.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was home when I saw the old man at the corner bakery arguing with the delivery guy over the last croissant. Pure Neukölln energy.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you find spontaneous barbecues in public parks, complete with improvised dance parties. It’s like community spirit in a bottle.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s from the Mission if they can spot a tourist by the way they fumble with the BART ticket machines during a meltdown.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a local artist rapping about Muni delays on the bus today—turns out nothing unites us like waiting for the 30 to show up.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think every bar has tapas, but many just serve vermut. A quiet afternoon can mean a full house; locals lounge, not rush.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their bewilderment at the ‘siesta’ silence creeping in around 3 PM, as locals vanish for a nap.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still say 'please' when ordering a coffee at Clissold Park café; everyone else just raises an eyebrow and expects a flat white.
Caught the 196 last night, and this bloke was trying to barter with the driver for a free ride. He offered a sandwich and a mixtape. Oddly, the driver laughed.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was home when I stumbled upon a pop-up flea market behind an old bakery, finding hand-painted ceramics and vintage records among the street art.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg do you find spontaneous open-air techno parties in the parks. It’s like a city-wide festival, free for everyone who stumbles upon it.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only locals know to pack extra snacks for a BART delay. Visitors stand around clueless while we stock up at the corner store.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni blooper today: driver stopped mid-route to help a lost tourist find their hotel. Classic Tenderloin spirit shining through.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is all about the plazas, but the real charm is in those hidden bakeries tucked away on side streets.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their bewildered expression while trying to figure out the metro ticket machines—it's a rite of passage.
